clips.title: The story
paras: Outside Menethil Harbor's Deepwater Tavern, First Mate Fitzsimmons drinks through the days. Once first mate of the Wave Mistress in Kul Tiras's Third Fleet, he is its sole known living survivor after the fleet's destruction in the Second War. Now he seeks travelers willing to face the restless spirits of his drowned comrades.

Outside the Deepwater Tavern in Menethil Harbor, First Mate Fitzsimmons drinks alone. His unwashed stench keeps many patrons away, and most see only a broken old sailor drowning his memories. Those who sit and listen hear how a proud fleet fell to fire and claw.

During the Second War, Fitzsimmons served aboard the Wave Mistress as first mate. The ship sailed with Kul Tiras's Third Fleet to fight the Horde. Off the Wetlands coast, Dragonmaw orcs ambushed the fleet with enslaved red dragons and burned its ships. The vessels broke apart and sank. Fitzsimmons alone managed to reach shore alive.
